column1: # M3_INTEGRATE rule table (pattern M3_TO_JDK_LAYOUT v1): one row per rule, first match wins, order is significant.
# Every m3/ path gets exactly one MAPPING.tsv row from the first rule that matches it; a path no rule matches is a
#   rule_id  kind(prefix|regex)  pattern  target  phase  status  reason
# target: RETIRE, or a template; {rest} = the path after a prefix pattern, {1}..{9} = regex groups,
#   {lib} = regex group 1 normalised to a module-name segment (lower case, [a-z0-9] only, version suffix dropped).
# status: MOVE (moved by this phase's PR), RETIRE (removal, separate approval PR), HOLD_APPROVAL (target module root does
#   not exist: needs the user's approval before anything moves), HOLD_P1 (product code: moves with its area's
#   move_area.py / move_module_area.py run and gates, one area per PR), AMBIGUOUS (moved by default, listed for review).
# ---- P4: not JDK source; absorb-first rule (user 2026-10-30): removal needs the user's approval, history keeps it.
#      RETIRE = no live build reads it; HOLD_APPROVAL = still read by workflows/tools (absorb first, then retire).
